Frozen Python 1.2 workflow source scalar values

etr_frozen_workflow_values.Rd

Return native R copies of three public scalar values defined by frozen eyetrajectoriespy 1.2.0 workflows/_core.py. The values document Python source metadata; they are not claims of native bundle-format interoperability or full scientific source equivalence.

Usage

etr_frozen_workflow_values()

Value

A named R list with two integer scalars, WORKFLOW_SCHEMA_VERSION and WORKFLOW_BUNDLE_SCHEMA_VERSION, and one character scalar, WORKFLOW_BUNDLE_FORMAT.

Details

The Python workflow bundle format string is eyetrajectoriespy-workflow-bundle. Native R workflow bundles use a different format. All source-object full-domain certification decisions remain independent and unapproved.

Examples

values <- etr_frozen_workflow_values()
stopifnot(identical(values$WORKFLOW_SCHEMA_VERSION, 1L))
